notes: §2002:12.3.4.6.3 GR4: with no alphabet-name-1 in the file control entry, the native alphanumeric sequence applies to every alphanumeric record key not named in a key-level COLLATING SEQUENCE format. l1c03 sets PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV; KF has only 'COLLATING SEQUENCE OF KF-KEY IS REV', so its ALTERNATE KF-ALT is native: 'KF ALT   Z/A A/M M/Z' (alternates A<M<Z); NF has no COLLATING SEQUENCE clause, so its prime is native: 'NF PRIME A/M M/Z Z/A'. A program sequence leaking to the keys would reverse both. l1c03_file_collating_native_default run at --std 2002 on the pinned build: PASS.
